title: SC12-T1 — the close (SH01a, SH01b, SH02a, SH02b, SH03a, SH03b)
line: So if someone ever looked at you and made you feel like you had faded, / please hear me. It was never you. / The thing she wanted to know, I will tell you instead. / It is called FACELOVE, and I have linked it below.
motionPlan: Michelle, at the patio table in the late sun, turns from the garden to the lens and speaks to it, warm and direct → Michelle, at the patio table in the late sun, turns from the garden to the lens and speaks to it, warm and direct → Michelle picks up the violet stick (a little longer than her hand is wide) and holds it up beside her face, wordmark to the lens → Michelle picks up the violet stick (a little longer than her hand is wide) and holds it up beside her face, wordmark to the lens → Michelle lowers the stick and looks out at the garden, her face easy and open, the late sun on her cheek → Michelle lowers the stick and looks out at the garden, her face easy and open, the late sun on her cheek
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
